question.prompt: What runnable starting URL should the Calculators navigation test use?

options.label: Use placeholder
options.detail: Keep the authored `{{calculators_page_url}}` variable until a real Calculators page URL is supplied.

options.label: Provide real URL
options.detail: Replace `{{calculators_page_url}}` with the actual Calculators page URL before running the test.

content.risk_rationale: Without a starting URL, the navigation behavior is specified but not runnable in the browser agent; this blocks execution of the highest-value test.
